rating_policy.rationale: Analyst-defined bands apply to modeled 12-month total return, including the change from the reference close to the DCF target and dividends attributable to holding the shares over the horizon. Buy at +10% or higher, Sell at -10% or lower, and Hold between those thresholds. Peer multiples provide a valuation cross-check.

catalysts.title: Gulfstream deliveries and mix
catalysts.detail: GD reported 40 third-quarter Gulfstream deliveries versus 39 a year earlier and 119 year to date versus 113. Aerospace book-to-bill was 1.4x in both periods. Fourth-quarter deliveries and cabin mix will test how quickly orders translate into aircraft revenue.

source.citation: General Dynamics third-quarter 2026 results, Exhibit 99.1, Exhibit G supplemental Aerospace data.

catalysts.title: Columbia and Virginia production
catalysts.detail: Electric Boat announced $29.5 billion for five additional Columbia-class submarines and $42.1 billion for nine additional Virginia-class submarines. Follow shipyard capacity and construction progress for evidence that the awards are supporting Marine Systems revenue growth.

source.citation: General Dynamics Electric Boat, July 29 announcement of submarine construction awards and support for shipyard infrastructure.

catalysts.title: Fourth-quarter cash conversion
catalysts.detail: GD updated FY2026 guidance to $56.5–$56.8 billion in revenue and $17.20–$17.30 in diluted EPS. Management expected capital expenditure to stay elevated in Q4. Year-end results will show how working capital and capacity investment affect cash conversion.

source.citation: General Dynamics third-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q, full-year outlook and liquidity sections.

risks.title: Backlog funding and submarine throughput
risks.detail: Marine Systems ended Q3 with $146.9 billion in backlog, of which $47.3 billion was funded. Shipbuilding capacity and appropriations can affect revenue timing. A continuing resolution extended federal funding through December 11, and GD expected that extension to have no material impact.

source.citation: General Dynamics third-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q, federal government, shipbuilding capacity and backlog discussions.

risks.title: Aircraft supply and segment margins
risks.detail: GD reported mid-cabin airframe delays and typically earns lower margins on initial aircraft production lots. Marine Systems' Q3 margin benefited partly from a favorable Virginia Block IV adjustment. Delivery mix and the timing of contract adjustments can affect future segment margins.

source.citation: General Dynamics third-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q, business aviation and Marine Systems results.

risks.title: Electric Boat accounting investigations
risks.detail: GD disclosed investigations and subpoenas concerning aspects of Electric Boat's submarine contract cost accounting and billing. GD was cooperating and could not estimate the outcome or possible loss. An adverse outcome could materially affect operations or cash flows.

source.citation: General Dynamics third-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q, Note J, Electric Boat investigations.
